epoch_2018-10-22.source: Table 2 (squeeze+model fitting columns; CANDID columns in canndid_alt), p. 24 of arXiv:2007.12320 PDF; orbit-fit use inferred from Fig. 25 (all five epochs plotted), p. 25

T_peri_unstated_system: Anugu+2020 Table 3 does not state the time system (MJD or RJD = MJD+0.5); fix it against the RV ephemeris before use
orbit.source: Table 3, p. 24; compared with Konacki et al. (2010) spectroscopic+interferometric orbit; text p. 22: 'The best-fit parameters very well match with spectroscopic observations Konacki et al. (2010)'. Flux ratio: 'We estimate a flux ratio of primary to secondary Fpri/sec of 4.6 +/- 0.1 ... compared with 5.0 +/- 0.5 reported by Konacki et al. (2010)', p. 22.

iot Peg.flux_ratio_definition: 'F_pri/sec' = flux ratio of primary to secondary (Table 2 header; text p. 22: 'flux ratio of primary to secondary F_pri/sec of 4.6 +/- 0.1'). H band implied (MIRC-X H-band data) but band not explicitly stated in the passage. NB primary/secondary, i.e. >1; invert for secondary/primary (~0.217).
iot Peg.uncertainties: Table 2 errors are the fit errors; no mention of inflation. Table 3: semi-major axis footnote '* 0.5% uncertainty in the semi-major due to uncertain absolute wavelength calibration' (i.e. the quoted +/-0.0038 mas is statistical only, 0.5% systematic additional). Median orbit residual 6.65 uas (Fig. 25 caption). Model-fit vs CANDID differences up to 3.3 sigma (Table 2 last columns).

conventions.PA: North up, East to the left in images (Fig. 24/25); PA of secondary relative to primary presumed east of north, not stated explicitly in the text read
conventions.omega: Table 3 'Longitude of the periastron'; whose component not stated
conventions.Omega: Table 3 footnote: 'Our orbit Omega is not in J2000, apparent North-East precession.' (i.e. epoch-of-date frame)
conventions.other: Table 3 T_peri unit not stated in the table (value 52997.4686, presumably MJD). Epoch MJDs not given in the paper (null here).

iot Peg.notes: Paper contains no separate dataset for the Imaging Workshop files; 2018-10-22 is one of the five MIRC-X epochs in Table 2 (rho 10.0352 +/- 0.0176 mas, PA 354.7005 +/- 0.019 deg, Fpri/sec 4.55 +/- 0.04). The workshop files (7 files, this date) are presumably the same night; not verifiable from the paper.

sig Ori.target: sigma Ori (Aa,Ab close pair; MIRC H prism, 2011-09-29)

publication_status.evidence: arXiv API record https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?id_list=1610.01984 lists arxiv:doi 10.3847/0004-6256/152/6/213 and comment 'Accepted by the Astronomical Journal'. Pages/tables below are from arXiv v1 (6 Oct 2016), not the published layout.

sig Ori.method: Sec. 2.2 (pp. 3-5): MIRC data (amdlib pipeline) fit per night with a scaled binary model (Aa,Ab close pair plus B as a third component in the flux budget); fit grid search + chi2 maps; alternative triple model (Aa,Ab,B with bandwidth smearing, 2.5 min blocks) was checked but the simpler scaled binary solution is reported. Closure triangles including S1-S2 excluded. Orbit (Sec. 4.1, p. 9): simultaneous Newton-Raphson fit of MIRC positions (Table 3), Simon-Diaz et al. (2015) RVs and new CTIO RVs. Priors not stated.
sig Ori.flux_ratio_definition: Not a single ratio: Table 3 lists per-epoch fractional flux contributions fAa, fAb, fB of the total H-band light on the detector (Sec. 2.2, p. 4: means 47.7% +/- 5.9% (Aa), 27.4% +/- 5.2% (Ab), 24.9% +/- 8.0% (B)). Ab/Aa ratio derived by me from Table 3 fractions (2011-09-29: 0.2549/0.4347 = 0.586). AMBER check: fitted magnitude difference Ab-Aa = 0.57 +/- 0.03 (H) and 0.55 +/- 0.02 (K); 'consistent with the CHARA value of Delta H = 0.60 mag' (Sec. 2.3, p. 5).
sig Ori.uncertainties: Table 3 note: error-ellipse axes 'scaled by a factor of 2.24 to force chi2_nu = 1 for an orbit fit to only the MIRC derived positions'. Wavelength-scale systematic of +/-0.25% (Monnier et al. 2012) on separations is propagated only into the second uncertainty on a in Table 9 (4.2860 +/- 0.0031 +/- 0.0107).

conventions.PA: theta measured east of north (Sec. 2.2, p. 4); of Ab relative to Aa (implied by Table 3 header 'Positions of sigma Ori Aa,Ab')
conventions.omega: omega_Aa = argument of periastron for the primary Aa; omega_Ab = omega_Aa + 180 deg = 19.83 (Table 9 footnote a, p. 23)
conventions.Omega: position angle of the line of nodes, 'Omega' (Sec. 4.1); equinox not stated for the close pair (Table 10 wide pair says J2000.0)
conventions.other: HJD column is HJD - 2,400,000 at the median time of observation; MJD not listed (HJD-2400000 minus ~0.5 would give 2011-09-29 ~55833.5, my derivation). Observation log Table 1 p. 16 lists 2011 Sep 29 as 55834.004, S1-S2-E1-E2-W1-W2, calibrators HD 25490 and HD 33256, 200 V2, 240 closure phases, r0 = 12.0 cm.
